widgetTool.name: acn-payment-carousel
widgetTool.description: Emit a scrollable list of accounts, transactions, or payment options for the user to select from. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me pull up your accounts.' Webchat only — on voice, read options aloud.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-payment-carousel'

payments.description: Required. An ordered list of scheduled payments to display.

cancellable.description: Whether the payment can be cancelled.

cta_label.description: Button label e.g. Cancel payment or Processing.

cta_value.description: Value sent to agent on button click e.g. cancel_payment:PMT-10001.

payee_name.description: Required. Name of the payee e.g. Hydro One.

status.description: Payment status: scheduled, processing, or cancelled.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
